title: Eye of Eternity Portal
description: A surreal scene shows a cloaked figure in a glowing blue chestpiece and red cape walking down a red pathway toward a giant triangular portal. Inside the triangle is a large red eye with a clock face background, tree roots, and gears, flanked by giant hands at the top corners. Silhouetted figures stand before a hypnotic colorful spiral tunnel.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork of a mysterious cloaked figure with glowing blue chestpiece and flowing red cape walking down a red pathway into a hypnotic tunnel. Above him is a massive triangular portal containing a large red all-seeing eye set in an ornate clock face with Roman numerals, dark tree roots, and golden gears. Two giant hands reach from the top corners. Silhouetted figures stand before a colorful spiral vortex. Dark atmospheric background with floating gears and blue symbols, mystical and ominous mood.
